chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When you have finished (with the burial at) the grave, sprinkle it with water, then place your hand by his head and press your palm upon it after the sprinkling.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual action after burying a deceased person according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via the reliable chain of Zurarah, establishes the physical etiquette of concluding the burial rite by sprinkling water on the grave to settle the dust. The specific gesture of placing the hand at the head and pressing the palm serves as a tangible act of *du'a* and blessing, symbolizing the mourner's final supplication for the deceased's peace before departing. This practice is rooted in the Shia tradition of maintaining a respectful, tactile connection with the grave during the immediate post-burial period.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you are free from the grave (burial), so sprinkle it with water, then place your hand by his head and press your palm upon it after the sprinkling’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When you complete the grave sprinkle water on it, then place your hand near the head of the deceased and depress your hand on it after sprinkling water.”’
